svg.title: The photoelectric effect
svg.desc: Kinetic energy KE_e of ejected electrons versus the frequency f of the light. No electrons are ejected below the threshold frequency f0 = BE/h; above it, KE_e = hf − BE rises in a straight line whose slope is Planck’s constant h. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Photoelectric emission has a frequency threshold
Illustrative work function 2.00 eV. Below threshold no photoelectron is emitted; above it K max = hf
− work. More intensity cannot remove this one-photon threshold.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
